BILINGUAL.EN: This section describes the details on how instruction sequences are represented and combined. Recall from section that an instruction sequence is represented as a list of the registers needed, the registers modified, and the actual instructions. We will also consider a label (symbol)(string) to be a degenerate case of an instruction sequence, which doesnt need or modify any registers. So to determine the registers needed and modified by instruction sequences we use the selectors
BILINGUAL.JA: この節では、命令列がどのように表現され結合されるかの詳細を説明します。節で見たように、命令列は必要レジスタ集合、変更レジスタ集合、そして実際の命令のリストとして表現されます。また、ラベル（シンボル）（文字列）は、レジスタを必要も変更もしない命令列の退化したケースと見なします。命令列が必要とするレジスタと変更するレジスタを判定するために、次のセレクタを使います。

SNIPPET.NAME: registers_needed
SNIPPET.SCHEME:
(define (registers-needed s) (if (symbol? s) '() (car s)))
(define (registers-modified s) (if (symbol? s) '() (cadr s)))
(define (statements s) (if (symbol? s) (list s) (caddr s)))

BILINGUAL.EN: and to determine whether a given sequence needs or modifies a given register we use the predicates
BILINGUAL.JA: また、ある命令列が特定のレジスタを必要とするか、または変更するかを判定するために、次の述語を使います。

SNIPPET.NAME: needs_register
SNIPPET.SCHEME:
(define (needs-register? seq reg) (memq reg (registers-needed seq)))
(define (modifies-register? seq reg) (memq reg (registers-modified seq)))

BILINGUAL.EN: In terms of these predicates and selectors, we can implement the various instruction sequence combiners used throughout the compiler.
BILINGUAL.JA: これらの述語とセレクタを使って、コンパイラ全体で使用されるさまざまな命令列結合子を実装できます。

BILINGUAL.EN:
The basic combiner is
append-instruction-sequences.
append_instruction_sequences.
This takes as arguments
an arbitrary number of two
instruction sequences that are to be executed sequentially and returns an instruction sequence whose statements are the statements of
all the the two
sequences appended together. The subtle point is to determine the registers that are needed and modified by the resulting sequence. It modifies those registers that
are modified by any of the sequences; are modified by either sequence;
it needs those registers that must be initialized before the first sequence can be run (the registers needed by the first sequence), together with those registers needed by
any of the other sequences that are not initialized (modified) by sequences preceding it. the second sequence that are not initialized (modified) by the first sequence.
BILINGUAL.JA:
基本的な結合子は
append-instruction-sequences append_instruction_sequences
です。これは、順次実行される任意個の2つの命令列を引数として受け取り、すべての2つの命令列の命令を結合した命令列を返します。微妙な点は、結果の命令列が必要とするレジスタと変更するレジスタをどう決定するかです。変更レジスタ集合は、いずれかの命令列が変更するレジスタの集合です。どちらかの命令列が変更するレジスタの集合です。必要レジスタ集合は、最初の命令列を実行する前に初期化されていなければならないレジスタ（最初の命令列の必要レジスタ集合）に加え、他の命令列が必要とするレジスタのうち、先行する命令列で初期化（変更）されないものです。2番目の命令列が必要とするレジスタのうち、最初の命令列で初期化（変更）されないものです。

BILINGUAL.EN:
The sequences are appended two at a time by append-2-sequences. This
The function append_instruction_sequences
is given two instruction sequences seq1 and seq2 and returns the instruction sequence whose
statements
instructions
are the
statements
instructions
of seq1 followed by the
statements
instructions
of seq2, whose modified registers are those registers that are modified by either seq1 or seq2, and whose needed registers are the registers needed by seq1 together with those registers needed by seq2 that are not modified by seq1. (In terms of set operations, the new set of needed registers is the union of the set of registers needed by seq1 with the set difference of the registers needed by seq2 and the registers modified by seq1.) Thus,
append-instruction-sequences
append_instruction_sequences
is implemented as follows:
BILINGUAL.JA:
命令列はappend-2-sequencesによって2つずつ結合されます。この関数は
関数append_instruction_sequencesは、
2つの命令列seq1とseq2を受け取り、文命令がseq1の文命令に続いてseq2の文命令を並べたものであり、変更レジスタ集合はseq1またはseq2のいずれかが変更するレジスタの集合であり、必要レジスタ集合はseq1が必要とするレジスタに加えてseq2が必要とするレジスタのうちseq1が変更しないもの、という命令列を返します。（集合演算で言えば、新しい必要レジスタ集合は、seq1の必要レジスタ集合と、seq2の必要レジスタ集合からseq1の変更レジスタ集合を引いた差集合との和集合です。）したがって、append-instruction-sequencesappend_instruction_sequencesは次のように実装されます。

SNIPPET.NAME: append_instruction_sequences
SNIPPET.SCHEME: (define (append-instruction-sequences . seqs) (define (append-2-sequences seq1 seq2) (make-instruction-sequence (list-union (registers-needed seq1) (list-difference (registers-needed seq2) (registers-modified seq1))) (list-union (registers-modified seq1) (registers-modified seq2)) (append (statements seq1) (statements seq2)))) (define (append-seq-list seqs) (if (null? seqs) (empty-instruction-sequence) (append-2-sequences (car seqs) (append-seq-list (cdr seqs))))) (append-seq-list seqs))

BILINGUAL.EN:
This
procedure function
uses some simple operations for manipulating sets represented as lists, similar to the (unordered) set representation described in section:
BILINGUAL.JA: この手続き関数は、節で説明した（順序なし）集合表現と同様の、リストとして表現された集合を操作するための単純な演算を使います。

SNIPPET.NAME: list_union
SNIPPET.SCHEME:
(define (list-union s1 s2) (cond ((null? s1) s2) ((memq (car s1) s2) (list-union (cdr s1) s2)) (else (cons (car s1) (list-union (cdr s1) s2)))))
(define (list-difference s1 s2) (cond ((null? s1) '()) ((memq (car s1) s2) (list-difference (cdr s1) s2)) (else (cons (car s1) (list-difference (cdr s1) s2)))))

BILINGUAL.EN:
Preserving,
The function preserving,
the second major instruction sequence combiner, takes a list of registers regs and two instruction sequences seq1 and seq2 that are to be executed sequentially. It returns an instruction sequence whose
statements
instructions
are the
statements
instructions
of seq1 followed by the
statements
instructions
of seq2, with appropriate save and restore instructions around seq1 to protect the registers in regs that are modified by seq1 but needed by seq2. To accomplish this, preserving first creates a sequence that has the required saves followed by the
statements
instructions
of seq1 followed by the required restores. This sequence needs the registers being saved and restored in addition to the registers needed by seq1, and modifies the registers modified by seq1 except for the ones being saved and restored. This augmented sequence and seq2 are then appended in the usual way. The following
procedure function
implements this strategy recursively, walking down the list of registers to be preserved:
BILINGUAL.JA:
Preservingは、
関数preservingは、
2番目の主要な命令列結合子であり、レジスタのリストregsと、順次実行される2つの命令列seq1とseq2を受け取ります。返される命令列の文命令は、seq1の文命令に続いてseq2の文命令を並べたものですが、seq1が変更しseq2が必要とするregs内のレジスタを保護するために、seq1の前後に適切なsave命令とrestore命令が付加されます。これを実現するために、preservingはまず、必要なsaveに続いてseq1の文命令、そして必要なrestoreを並べた命令列を作成します。この命令列は、seq1が必要とするレジスタに加えて、保存・復元されるレジスタも必要とし、変更レジスタ集合はseq1が変更するレジスタから保存・復元されるレジスタを除いたものになります。この拡張された命令列とseq2が通常の方法で結合されます。次の手続き関数は、保存すべきレジスタのリストを辿りながら、この戦略を再帰的に実装しています。

SCHEME.FOOTNOTE: Note that preserving calls append with three appendarbitrarywith arbitrary number of arguments arguments. Though the definition of append shown in this book accepts only two arguments, Scheme standardly provides an append procedure that takes an arbitrary number of arguments.

SNIPPET.NAME: preserving
SNIPPET.SCHEME: (define (preserving regs seq1 seq2) (if (null? regs) (append-instruction-sequences seq1 seq2) (let ((first-reg (car regs))) (if (and (needs-register? seq2 first-reg) (modifies-register? seq1 first-reg)) (preserving (cdr regs) (make-instruction-sequence (list-union (list first-reg) (registers-needed seq1)) (list-difference (registers-modified seq1) (list first-reg)) (append `((save ,first-reg)) (statements seq1) `((restore ,first-reg)))) seq2) (preserving (cdr regs) seq1 seq2)))))

BILINGUAL.EN:
Another sequence combiner,
tack-on-instruction-sequence,
tack_on_instruction_sequence,
is used by
compile-lambda compile_lambda_expression
to append a
procedure function
body to another sequence. Because the
procedure function
body is not in line to be executed as part of the combined sequence, its register use has no impact on the register use of the sequence in which it is embedded. We thus ignore the
procedure function
bodys sets of needed and modified registers when we tack it onto the other sequence.
BILINGUAL.JA:
もう一つの命令列結合子
tack-on-instruction-sequence tack_on_instruction_sequence
は、compile-lambdacompile_lambda_expressionが手続き関数の本体を別の命令列に付加するために使います。手続き関数の本体は、結合された命令列の一部としてインラインで実行されるわけではないので、そのレジスタの使用は、それが埋め込まれている命令列のレジスタ使用に影響を与えません。したがって、手続き関数の本体を別の命令列に付加する際には、本体の必要レジスタ集合と変更レジスタ集合を無視します。

SNIPPET.NAME: tack_on_instruction_sequence
SNIPPET.SCHEME: (define (tack-on-instruction-sequence seq body-seq) (make-instruction-sequence (registers-needed seq) (registers-modified seq) (append (statements seq) (statements body-seq))))

BILINGUAL.EN:
Compile-if The functions compile_conditional
and
compile-procedure-call
compile_function_call
use a special combiner called
parallel-instruction-sequences
parallel_instruction_sequences
to append the two alternative branches that follow a test. The two branches will never be executed sequentially; for any particular evaluation of the test, one branch or the other will be entered. Because of this, the registers needed by the second branch are still needed by the combined sequence, even if these are modified by the first branch.
BILINGUAL.JA:
Compile-if 関数compile_conditional
と
compile-procedure-call compile_function_call
は、テストに続く2つの代替分岐を結合するために、
parallel-instruction-sequences parallel_instruction_sequences
という特別な結合子を使います。2つの分岐が順次実行されることは決してありません。テストの特定の評価に対して、一方の分岐だけが実行されます。このため、2番目の分岐が必要とするレジスタは、たとえそれが最初の分岐で変更されるとしても、結合された命令列にとって依然として必要です。

SNIPPET.NAME: parallel_instruction_sequences
SNIPPET.SCHEME: (define (parallel-instruction-sequences seq1 seq2) (make-instruction-sequence (list-union (registers-needed seq1) (registers-needed seq2)) (list-union (registers-modified seq1) (registers-modified seq2)) (append (statements seq1) (statements seq2))))
